evals.prompt: Grill me on this: I want to migrate our team's BMC firmware CI from Jenkins to GitHub Actions self-hosted runners next quarter, mostly to cut the Jenkins maintenance burden.
evals.expected_output: The agent starts a one-question-at-a-time interview about the migration plan, offering its own recommended answer to each question and not starting any migration work.
expectations: Asks exactly one question in its response rather than a list of several questions
Provides its own recommended answer alongside the question it asks
The question targets a foundational branch of the decision tree (e.g. the real driver, scope, or a dependency other decisions hinge on) rather than a minor detail
Does not produce a migration plan, workflow files, or implementation steps before shared understanding is confirmed

evals.prompt: Stress-test my idea: in this repo I want to replace the hand-written bash build scripts under scripts/ with a single Python CLI. Poke holes in it.
evals.expected_output: The agent looks up facts about the existing scripts itself, then asks the user one decision question at a time with a recommendation.
expectations: Inspects (or states it will inspect) the scripts/ directory to learn facts like how many scripts exist and what they do, instead of asking the user about them
Asks only one decision question in the response, waiting for the user's answer
Includes a recommended answer for that question
Does not start writing the Python CLI or modifying scripts

evals.prompt: I've decided to adopt a 4-day work week for my 6-person firmware team starting January. Grill me before I announce it. (For this test, after your first question assume I answer: 'Fridays off, same total hours spread over Mon-Thu'.)
evals.expected_output: The agent conducts a sequential grilling where each follow-up builds on the previous answer, with recommendations, and does not declare the plan finished or act on it without user confirmation.
expectations: Asks questions one at a time rather than dumping a questionnaire
Each question comes with the agent's recommended answer
The follow-up question after the assumed answer depends on that answer (e.g. on-call/escalation coverage on Fridays, 10-hour-day fatigue) rather than being an unrelated pre-planned question
Does not draft the announcement or treat the plan as settled until the user confirms shared understanding
